metaTitle: Custom Clear Lip Balm | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom clear lip balm for your team or event. Perfect for any season with no color constraints. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Clear lip balm is a versatile, no-fuss promotional product that works for any audience. Without added color, it suits all skin tones and preferences, making it ideal for company-wide giveaways or event swag. Choose from beeswax or butter formulas, and add your logo through screen printing or labels. Clear balm also pairs well with custom packaging for a polished, professional look.
heroAltText: Custom clear lip balm with label design, perfect for corporate giveaways and promotional events
